---
title: Test
format: 
  html:
    number-sections: true
toastui:
  options-all:
    defaultView: week
    height: 660px
    navigation: true
    date: "2026-04-15"
    file: data/events.tsv
    file-sep: "\t"
    isReadOnly: true
    useDetailPopup: true
    timeFormat: "24h"
    usageStatistics: false
    gridSelection:
      enableClick: true
      enableDblClick: false
    month:
      startDayOfWeek: 1
      narrowWeekend: true
      workweek: false
      visibleWeeksCount: 0
      isAlways6Weeks: true
      visibleEventCount: 6
    week:
      startDayOfWeek: 1
      narrowWeekend: false
      workweek: false
      showNowIndicator: true
      showTimezoneCollapseButton: false
      timezonesCollapsed: false
      hourStart: 6
      hourEnd: 22
      eventView: true
      taskView: true
      collapseDuplicateEvents: false
    timezone:
      zones:
        - timezoneName: Europe/Stockholm
          displayLabel: Stockholm
        - timezoneName: Europe/London
          displayLabel: London
    theme:
      common:
        backgroundColor: "#ffffff"
    template:
      milestone: "${title}"
    calendars:
      - id: cal1
        name: Personal
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#03bd9e"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#03bd9e"
        borderColor: "#03bd9e"
      - id: cal2
        name: Work
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#00a9ff"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#00a9ff"
        borderColor: "#00a9ff"

  options-no-nav:
    defaultView: day
    date: "2026-04-15"
    navigation: false
    file: data/events.tsv
    file-sep: "\t"
    week:
      eventView:
        - time
      taskView: false

  options-week-time-only-no-buttons:
    defaultView: week
    navigation: false
    isReadOnly: false
    date: "2026-04-17"
    file: data/events.csv
    file-sep: ","
    week:
      eventView:
        - time
      taskView: false
    calendars:
      - id: cal1
        name: Personal
        backgroundColor: "#03bd9e"
      - id: cal2
        name: Work
        backgroundColor: "#00a9ff"

  options-icon-test:
    defaultView: week
    height: 680px
    navigation: true
    date: "2026-04-15"
    isReadOnly: false
    useFormPopup: true
    useDetailPopup: true
    timeFormat: "24h"
    eventDetailItems:
      - location
      - recurrenceRule
      - attendees
      - state
    popupDetailItems:
      - location
      - recurrenceRule
      - attendees
      - state
      - calendar
      - body
    gridSelection:
      enableClick: true
      enableDblClick: true
    week:
      startDayOfWeek: 1
      hourStart: 8
      hourEnd: 18
      eventView: true
      taskView:
        - milestone
        - task
      showTimezoneCollapseButton: true
      timezonesCollapsed: false
    timezone:
      zones:
        - timezoneName: Europe/Stockholm
          displayLabel: Stockholm
        - timezoneName: Europe/London
          displayLabel: London
    calendars:
      - id: icon-work
        name: Work
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#087f8c"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#087f8c"
        borderColor: "#087f8c"
      - id: icon-personal
        name: Personal
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#c44d58"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#c44d58"
        borderColor: "#c44d58"
    events:
      - id: icon-milestone
        calendarId: icon-work
        title: "Release milestone"
        category: milestone
        start: "2026-04-13"
        end: "2026-04-13"
      - id: icon-task
        calendarId: icon-work
        title: "Prepare release notes"
        category: task
        start: "2026-04-14"
        end: "2026-04-14"
      - id: icon-allday
        calendarId: icon-personal
        title: "Conference day"
        category: allday
        isAllday: true
        start: "2026-04-15"
        end: "2026-04-15"
      - id: icon-private
        calendarId: icon-work
        title: "Private planning"
        category: time
        start: "2026-04-14T09:00:00"
        end: "2026-04-14T10:30:00"
        location: "Board room"
        recurrenceRule: "Weekly"
        attendees:
          - Alex
          - Morgan
        state: "Busy"
        body: "Review the confidential launch plan."
        isPrivate: true
      - id: icon-public
        calendarId: icon-personal
        title: "Open design review"
        category: time
        start: "2026-04-16T11:00:00"
        end: "2026-04-16T12:30:00"
        location: "Studio A"
        recurrenceRule: "Every other Thursday"
        attendees:

        state: "Free"
        body: "Bring the current design proposal."
        isPrivate: false

  long-labels:
    defaultView: week

    file: "data/events-long-labels.csv"
    file-sep: ","
    useDetailPopup: true
    eventDetailItems:

      - arbitrary
      - body
    popupDetailItems:
      - location
      - attendees
      - state
      - arbitrary
      - body
    week:
      eventView: true
      taskView: false
    calendars:
      - id: cal1
        name: Work
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#087f8c"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#087f8c"
        borderColor: "#087f8c"
      - id: cal2
        name: Personal
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#c44d58"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#c44d58"
        borderColor: "#c44d58"

## YAML metadata
### Full configuration

- Calendar renders with custom options
- Events load from file
- Initial date is applied
- Navigation controls are visible
- Timed events, time-grid labels, and detail popups use 24-hour format

<details>
<summary>Show code</summary>

```yaml
---
toastui:
  options-all:
    defaultView: week
    height: 660px
    navigation: true
    date: "2026-04-15"
    file: data/events.tsv
    file-sep: "\t"
    isReadOnly: true
    useDetailPopup: true
    timeFormat: "24h"
    usageStatistics: false
    gridSelection:
      enableClick: true
      enableDblClick: false
    month:
      startDayOfWeek: 1
      narrowWeekend: true
      workweek: false
      visibleWeeksCount: 0
      isAlways6Weeks: true
      visibleEventCount: 6
    week:
      startDayOfWeek: 1
      narrowWeekend: false
      workweek: false
      showNowIndicator: true
      showTimezoneCollapseButton: false
      timezonesCollapsed: false
      hourStart: 6
      hourEnd: 22
      eventView: true
      taskView: true
      collapseDuplicateEvents: false
    timezone:
      zones:
        - timezoneName: Europe/Stockholm
          displayLabel: Stockholm
        - timezoneName: Europe/London
          displayLabel: London
    theme:
      common:
        backgroundColor: "#ffffff"
    template:
      milestone: "${title}"
    calendars:
      - id: cal1
        name: Personal
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#03bd9e"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#03bd9e"
        borderColor: "#03bd9e"
      - id: cal2
        name: Work
        color: "#ffffff"
        backgroundColor: "#00a9ff"
        dragBackgroundColor: "#00a9ff"
        borderColor: "#00a9ff"

---

{{{< toastui options-all >}}}
```

</details>

{{< toastui options-all >}}

### Navigation disabled

- No custom nav toolbar is shown
- Events load from file and are visible in the calendar
- Initial date is applied
- Week view shows only time panel and hides task/milestone panels

<details>
<summary>Show code</summary>

```yaml
---
toastui:
  options-no-nav:
    defaultView: day
    date: "2026-04-15"
    navigation: false
    file: data/events.tsv
    file-sep: "\t"
    week:
      eventView:
        - time
      taskView: false
---

{{{< toastui options-no-nav >}}}
```

</details>

{{< toastui options-no-nav >}}

### Week view no navigation

- Calendar opens in week view
- Milestone/task/allday panels are hidden (`taskView: false`, `eventView: [time]`)
- Month/week/day buttons are hidden (custom navigation disabled)

<details>
<summary>Show code</summary>

```yaml
---
toastui:
  options-week-time-only-no-buttons:
    defaultView: week
    navigation: false
    isReadOnly: false
    date: "2026-04-17"
    file: data/events.csv
    file-sep: ","
    week:
      eventView:
        - time
      taskView: false
    calendars:
      - id: cal1
        name: Personal
        backgroundColor: "#03bd9e"
      - id: cal2
        name: Work
        backgroundColor: "#00a9ff"
---

{{{< toastui options-week-time-only-no-buttons >}}}
```

</details>

.toastui-icon-test-grid {

}

  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.toastui-icon-test-symbol {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 24px;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: #fff;
}

.toastui-icon-test-symbol-dark {

}

.toastui-icon-test-grid [class*="toastui-calendar-ic-"] {
  background-position: center;
}

.toastui-icon-test-grid .toastui-calendar-resize-handler-x {

  width: 8px;
  height: 4px;

}
